title: Demystifying Web Development: From Web2 to Web3 & Real-World Architecture
abstract: Conducted an in-depth technical seminar for 60+ junior engineering students, bridging academic fundamentals with production system design, modern multi-protocol communication architectures, and decentralized state machines.

photos.alt: Audience and projection screen at seminar
photos.label: 60+ Attendees • Interactive Q&A

syllabus.title: 01. Modern API Protocols: REST, WebSockets, GraphQL & Webhooks
syllabus.body: Deconstructed real-world communication models: stateless HTTP RESTful contracts, full-duplex persistent WebSockets for live bi-directional streaming, schema-driven GraphQL queries/mutations to eliminate over-fetching, and event-driven Webhooks for asynchronous third-party callbacks.

syllabus.title: 02. Enterprise Database Connectivity & Data Flow
syllabus.body: Detailed the end-to-end client-server lifecycle, connection pooling, transactional ACID guarantees, relational vs document models (MySQL & MongoDB), and secure ORM/ODM integration patterns.

syllabus.title: 03. Web3, Blockchain & Smart Contract Architecture
syllabus.body: Introduced cryptographic hashing, distributed consensus mechanisms, immutable ledger state, smart contract execution boundaries, and how modern web clients bridge to decentralized networks.
